summary: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model settings for an EdgeNeXt-xsmall ImageClassifier backbone with a LinearClsHead for 1000-class classification, used within the Meta Sapiens pretraining framework (MMEngine-style configs).
use_cases: configure an EdgeNeXt-xsmall backbone for image classification with 1000 classes
set drop_path_rate to 0.1 for stochastic depth regularization in EdgeNeXt
define TruncNormal initialization for Conv2d and Linear layers with std=0.02
configure a LinearClsHead with CrossEntropyLoss for classification tasks
set gap_before_final_norm=True to apply global average pooling before the final layer norm

examples.configure_edgenext_xsmall_backbone: configure an EdgeNeXt-xsmall backbone with drop_path_rate 0.1 and out_indices (3,)
examples.set_truncnormal_init: set TruncNormal initialization with std 0.02 for Conv2d and Linear layers
examples.configure_linear_cls_head: configure a LinearClsHead with 1000 classes and CrossEntropyLoss
examples.set_gap_before_final_norm: set gap_before_final_norm to True for global average pooling before final norm
examples.review_model_config: review the EdgeNeXt-xsmall model config for ImageClassifier backbone and head settings
